description: A Bot's tasks, on the side panel's Tasks page (Baude's) and the Android app's, and what their host says of their runs: scripts run by hand or as a trigger fires, their inputs, their runs and their logs.

messages.title: Tasks
messages.status: .input {$status :string} .match $status running {{running}} asking {{asking its Bot}} done {{done}} failed {{failed}} stopped {{stopped}} skipped {{skipped}} * {{{$status}}}
messages.couldnt: .input {$doing :string} .match $doing load {{Couldn't load the tasks.}} run {{Couldn't run the task.}} save {{Couldn't save the task.}} delete {{Couldn't delete the task.}} stop {{Couldn't stop the run.}} * {{Couldn't {$doing} the task.}}
messages.asked: .input {$error :string} .match $error error {{(Your task's run {$run} failed, and it's handed to you.)}} * {{(Your task's run {$run} asks you this.)}}
messages.still_running: skipped: its last run is still going
